title: Growth versus equity in a stochastic multiplicative wealth model: The cost of redistribution and the emergence of an inequality Laffer curve
abstract: arXiv:2611.27993v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A stochastic multiplicative wealth model with taxation and redistribution is extended to include two channels through which fiscal policy can reduce the economy's average growth rate: productive disincentive (a tax-dependent mean return) and administrative inefficiency (loss of part of the collected revenue). For uniform redistribution, the stationary density of normalized wealth remains an inverse-gamma law, but its shape parameter acquires a richer dependence on the tax rate. The central finding is the emergence of an "inequality Laffer curve": when the disincentive is sufficiently strong, the Gini coefficient first decreases, reaches a minimum at a finite tax rate, and then increases again as taxation intensifies. In the extreme limit the stationary state collapses back to the condensed phase, restoring the oligarchic transition. translated_title: 随机乘性财富模型中的增长与公平：再分配的代价与“不平等拉弗曲线”的出现
translated_abstract: 本文将带税收与再分配的随机乘性财富模型加以扩展，纳入了财政政策降低经济平均增长率的两个渠道：生产性抑制（平均收益率依赖于税率）和行政低效（征收的部分收入流失）。在均匀再分配下，标准化财富的平稳密度仍保持逆伽马分布，但其形状参数对税率呈现出更丰富的依赖关系。核心发现是“不平等拉弗曲线”的出现：当抑制作用足够强时，基尼系数首先下降，在某一有限税率处达到最小值，随后随着税收的加强而再次上升。在极端极限下，平稳态坍缩回凝聚相，重新出现寡头化转变。这两个渠道还在不平等与长期平均财富之间造成了直接的权衡关系……
tldr: 本文在随机乘性财富模型中引入生产性抑制与行政低效两个增长损耗渠道，发现了“不平等拉弗曲线”现象——基尼系数随税率先降后升，揭示了再分配政策中效率与公平之间的根本权衡。
en_tdlr: By introducing productive disincentive and administrative inefficiency into a stochastic multiplicative wealth model, this paper reveals an "inequality Laffer curve" in which the Gini coefficient first decreases and then rises with the tax rate, exposing a fundamental trade-off between efficiency and equity in redistributive policy.
